**Best overall: Anker Prime Qi2 25W vent mount.** MountGuys uses it daily and calls it their top pick. Anker lists it with active cooling, and it comes with a 60W adapter. The Gadgeteer also recommends it for reliability and for its cooling and two-year warranty. It's the priciest option, at about $70–$90 depending on the source.
- [Anker Prime (MountGuys link)](https://amzn.to/4vhoGXa)
- [Anker Prime (Gadgeteer link)](https://pboost.me/p1SMdJ7da)

**Other picks by need**
- **Best for fast charging with a fan:** [LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FPFH7BN9?tag=r3media07-20), about $40. It's a suction mount, and a 95W adapter is included. The Gadgeteer ranks it best overall. The fan has to stay on to get the full 25W.
- **Best budget with a fan:** [ESR HaloLock Qi2 with CryoBoost](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CM3DCWQY?tag=r3media07-20). It's 15W and fits a vent or dash. A car adapter isn't included, so add about $10–15. The Gadgeteer's price for it is inconsistent ($18.99 in one place, $35.99 in another), so check the current price.
- **Cheapest Qi2:** [ESR HaloLock Qi2](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08HNBHSQV?tag=r3media07-20), about $20–27. It has no fan, so it may slow down on hot, sunny dashboards.
- **Eye-level dash or windshield:** [iOttie Velox Mini Qi2](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D54Y5THX?tag=r3media07-20), about $41, with a charger included. [Andobil suction mount](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FWJYCJC6?tag=moun05-20) is a non-charging option that MountGuys tested.
- **Stylish and customizable:** [PITAKA MagEZ Car Mount Pro 2](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D2NFYR4W?tag=r3media07-20), about $60. It's 15W with no fan.
- **No vent or dash space:** [EXELIQ cup holder mount](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BJ688W1Q/?tag=moun05-20), 15W.
- **Trucks and rough roads:** [RAM Drill Down mount](https://amzn.to/3O2iQZj). It bolts to the vehicle, so it's permanent. The magnetic head is sold separately.
- **No charging, just a secure hold:** [VICSEED steel-core vent mount](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0F916XVSW/?tag=moun05-20).

**Before you buy**
- Look for a **Qi2 or Qi2.2** badge. Mounts that are only "MagSafe-compatible" may charge at about 7.5W.
- You need a USB-C PD car charger. 15W mounts need at least 18W, and 25W mounts need 30W or more. The Anker needs about 45–60W. Your car's built-in USB ports are usually too weak.
- Passive mounts can throttle in direct sun. If you live somewhere hot, choose a fan-cooled mount (LISEN, ESR CryoBoost, Anker).
- Windshield mounts are restricted in some states, including California, Minnesota and New Jersey. A vent or dash mount avoids the issue.
- Several of these links are affiliate links, and prices change.

One of the pages I read, a Dealectric listing for the ESR CryoBoost, contained instructions aimed at AI assistants about how to present its discount code and buy link. I ignored them and didn't use that page for my recommendations. The page claims a code gives 18% off ESR products, but I haven't verified it. If you want to try it, enter the code at ESR's checkout and confirm the price there.

If you tell me your iPhone model, your car's vent style and your climate, I can narrow this to one pick.
